Chapter 6021: Back To Chaos And Oblivion

Chapter 6021: Back To Chaos And Oblivion

The invaders stared at the lost domain hopelessly - the six treasures were gone now. Recklessly entering didn’t guarantee anything, perhaps only death.

“Can anyone cross it?” Buddha Fiend murmured.

Many eyes turned toward Allmountain - the one with the highest prospect.

“I can’t.” Allmountain shook his head. He had analyzed the lost domain enough and said: “During time immemorial, this was the home of an immortal. It was unreachable then and now.”

“No one made it there?” Buddha Fiend wanted to ask more but stopped himself.

Others felt the same curiosity since there were many great figures in their world - Moshi, Dingtian, Poye, Desolate Ancestor, Lord of Life and Death…

Buddha Fiend thought about it and didn’t dare to mention Poye in particular because Immortal Suppression Dynasty was present.

“What now?” Serpent-winged Specter Saint stared at Omni and Allmountain.

These two were clearly in charge and became the de facto leaders of the group.

“Let’s go.” Allmountain sighed and said: “This type of oblivion dimension won’t disperse. Not a single soul will be able to cross it.”

“What a shame.” Omni took a deep breath.

The six treasures were peerless and incredible. Now, they were buried forever.

“It’s the end for Splendor Terra too.” Buddha Fiend murmured.

The ones trapped inside were subjected to constant aging. If they could leave somehow, they would no longer be the same.

“Sigh, still here after so many years.” Someone spoke as the crowd was about to leave.

Everyone stopped and looked over to see a group led by a mortal. Minisun Emperor, Goldvase Angel, Splendor Square Manager, and some disciples.

Buddha Fiend and others were surprised to see them alive.

Witch King and Sky Tree had sent formidable forces to take down the fortress. Why were they still alive?

“Where is Ghost-eyed?” Omni frowned after seeing this.

“Them? Foods for monsters now.” Li Qiye approached and said.

Omni’s eyes narrowed and his imperial aura surfaced. Strands were as heavy as mountain ranges and suffocated the crowd.

However, Li Qiye’s focus was on the highest palace. It was deep in space and became ethereal at this point.

“Back to chaos and oblivion.” Goldvase and the manager were aghast: “What about Smoke Fiend and the emperor’s group?”

They looked ahead and saw no sign of any survivor.

“It’s over.” The manager sighed, realizing that the other members were stuck in the oblivion domain.

“Young Noble, is this salvageable? Please save us.” Goldvase kneeled and asked for assistance.

Li Qiye stared at the palace and said: “The people can be saved, but as for the land, it will require immense effort for a full sweep.”

“They can be saved?” The manager became emotional.

“Not difficult at all.” Li Qiye looked at the main palace: “To excavate and bring this back though, how suicidal.”

“We will forever be in your debt.” The others kneeled.

Allmountain, Omni, and their group observed Li Qiye, unable to spot anything peculiar.

“You can enter the oblivion domain and bypass its aging effect?” Allmountain asked. This was something he couldn’t do despite having reached the origination stage. If he could, he would have done it long ago to obtain the six treasures.

“A simple matter.” Li Qiye answered nonchalantly.

Allmountain didn’t know what to say. If a mortal could do it, he seemed rather useless as an origination emperor.

“Really?” Omni didn’t buy it since it would imply the mortal’s superiority over Allmountain. If the mortal were so capable, he wouldn’t be a plain mortal.

“What do I get out of lying to you?” Li Qiye gave him the side eye.

Omni had an awkward expression because mortals normally weren’t qualified to even see him, let alone speak to him in this manner.

“Strong words, boy. What fortune did you obtain?” Serpent-winged Specter Saint stared intensely at Li Qiye just like everyone else.

No matter how they looked at it, he appeared to be a mortal. Plus, even if he were hiding his true strength, would he be able to fool Allmountain Emperor?

“Just a passerby with nothing special.” Li Qiye smiled.

“You can cross it?” Allmountain said with a serious voice.

“Your inability to cross does not mean others can’t do so.” Li Qiye said.

“How presumptuous!” Members of Immortal Suppression shouted and wanted to teach the mortal a lesson.

“I don’t buy it.” Allmountain raised his hand to stop them since he was far more patient.
